methods.method_description: Click on Add icon button on Printers screen
methods.method_purpose: Clicks the add printer button on the Printers screen, attempting primary button first and falling back to alternative button if not found. Ends on Add Printer screen or popup for first-time users.

methods.method_description: Select a printer from the list by printer name

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to select from the list
Flag indicating if printer was found via search

methods.method_purpose: Selects a printer from the printers list by clicking on the printer name element. Handles searched printers differently by using search result locator.

methods.method_description: Select Network Printer option on Add Printer screen
methods.method_purpose: Clicks on the Network Printer option in the Add Printer screen to proceed with network printer setup.

methods.method_description: Select USB Printer option on Add Printer screen
methods.method_purpose: Clicks on the USB Printer option in the Add Printer screen to proceed with USB printer setup.

methods.method_description: Select printer model from the list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Model name of the printer to select

methods.method_purpose: Selects a specific printer model from the available printer models list by clicking on the printer name.

methods.method_description: Enter printer name in the text field

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name to enter for the printer

methods.method_purpose: Inputs the specified printer name into the printer name text field.

methods.method_description: Enter printer IP address in the text field

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: IP address to enter for the printer

methods.method_purpose: Inputs the specified IP address into the printer IP address text field.

methods.method_description: Click Add Printer button to complete printer setup
methods.method_purpose: Clicks the Add Printer button to finalize and add the configured printer to the system.

methods.method_description: Verify that printer was successfully added to the list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to verify in the list
Maximum time in seconds to wait for printer to appear

methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean indicating if printer was found in the list
methods.method_purpose: Verifies that a printer with the specified name appears in the printers list within the timeout period, returning True if found, False otherwise.

methods.method_description: Remove a printer from the printers list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to remove

methods.method_purpose: Removes the specified printer from the printers list by accessing printer options and selecting the remove/delete action.

methods.method_description: Search for a printer using the search functionality

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to search for

methods.method_purpose: Uses the search feature to find a printer by entering the printer name in the search field and executing the search.

methods.method_description: Verify 'My printer is not listed' message is displayed

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time in seconds to wait for message

methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean indicating if message is displayed
methods.method_purpose: Checks if the 'My printer is not listed' message is visible on the screen within the specified timeout, returning True if displayed, False otherwise.

methods.method_description: Open settings for a specific printer

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to access settings for

methods.method_purpose: Navigates to the settings screen for the specified printer by selecting the printer and accessing its settings menu.

methods.method_description: Verify the status of a printer in the list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to check status for
Expected status string to verify against

methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean indicating if status matches expected value
methods.method_purpose: Verifies that the displayed status of the specified printer matches the expected status value, returning True if matched, False otherwise.
